                gold_entities.add((e.get('text',''), e.get('start',-1), e.get('end',-1), e.get('type','')))
            elif isinstance(e, (list, tuple)) and len(e) >= 4:
                gold_entities.add(tuple(e[:4]))
        
        if not gold_entities:
            continue  # skip gold-empty (consistent with recompute script)
        
        # Determine dominant entity type for this instance
        types_in_instance = set()
        for e in gold_entities:
            if isinstance(e, tuple) and len(e) >= 4:
                types_in_instance.add(e[3])
        
        if not types_in_instance:
            continue
        
        # For multi-type instances, use the most common type
        dominant_type = max(types_in_instance, key=lambda t: sum(1 for e in gold_entities if e[3] == t))
        
        # Parse samples
        all_samples = d.get('samples', [])
        if not all_samples:
            continue
            
        # Greedy = first sample
        greedy_entities = set()
        for e in all_samples[0].get('entities', []):
            if isinstance(e, dict):
                greedy_entities.add((e.get('text',''), e.get('start',-1), e.get('end',-1), e.get('type','')))
            elif isinstance(e, (list, tuple)) and len(e) >= 4:
                greedy_entities.add(tuple(e[:4]))
        
        greedy_f1 = compute_f1(greedy_entities, gold_entities)
        
        # MV strict: count entity votes across all samples
        entity_votes = defaultdict(int)
        sample_f1s = []
        for s in all_samples:
            sample_entities = set()
            for e in s.get('entities', []):
                if isinstance(e, dict):
                    ent = (e.get('text',''), e.get('start',-1), e.get('end',-1), e.get('type',''))
                elif isinstance(e, (list, tuple)) and len(e) >= 4:
                    ent = tuple(e[:4])
                else:
                    continue
                sample_entities.add(ent)
                entity_votes[ent] += 1
            sample_f1s.append(compute_f1(sample_entities, gold_entities))
        
        mv_entities = {e for e, v in entity_votes.items() if v > threshold}
        mv_f1 = compute_f1(mv_entities, gold_entities)
        oracle_f1 = max(sample_f1s) if sample_f1s else 0.0
        
        type_data[dominant_type]['greedy_f1'].append(greedy_f1)
        type_data[dominant_type]['mv_f1'].append(mv_f1)
        type_data[dominant_type]['oracle_f1'].append(oracle_f1)

# Report
print(f"{'Type':<30} {'N':>6} {'Greedy F1':>10} {'MV F1':>10} {'MV Δ':>10} {'Oracle F1':>10}")
print("-" * 80)

results = []
for t in sorted(type_data.keys()):
    d = type_data[t]
    n = len(d['greedy_f1'])
    g = sum(d['greedy_f1']) / n
    m = sum(d['mv_f1']) / n
    o = sum(d['oracle_f1']) / n
    delta = m - g
    results.append((t, n, g, m, delta, o))
    print(f"{t:<30} {n:>6} {g:>10.4f} {m:>10.4f} {delta:>+10.4f} {o:>10.4f}")

# Correlation: greedy_f1 vs MV delta
import statistics
greedy_vals = [r[2] for r in results]
delta_vals = [r[4] for r in results]
if len(results) >= 3:
    mean_g = statistics.mean(greedy_vals)
    mean_d = statistics.mean(delta_vals)
    cov = sum((g-mean_g)*(d-mean_d) for g,d in zip(greedy_vals, delta_vals)) / len(results)
    std_g = statistics.stdev(greedy_vals) if len(results) > 1 else 1
    std_d = statistics.stdev(delta_vals) if len(results) > 1 else 1
    corr = cov / (std_g * std_d) if (std_g * std_d) > 0 else 0
    print(f"\nCorrelation(greedy_f1, MV_delta) = {corr:.4f}")
    print(f"  (Negative = high-F1 types lose more from MV → baseline quality confound)")
